params.body:
A rehearsal compiled the rule book into `bextrust/build/rules-version.json`, the file a gate on the same machine may be reading. A gate only starts under the version its council approved, so after a rehearsal that gate refused to start. `simulate.sh` wrote to the same file.

- Each run compiles the rule book into its own folder.
- `phone-sim.sh up` beside a gate already set up writes `rules-version-next.json` and leaves the approved version alone.
- `phone-sim.sh resume` reads the version named in the gate's configuration.
- The front page marks `gate-demo-box` as archived and leaves it out of the clone command.

Checked: `go test ./...` passes; `simulate.sh` holds from a clean checkout and writes nothing in `build/`; the build step of `phone-sim.sh` writes only to its own folder, with and without a gate set up. `rehearse` and `resume` were not run in full with this change.

A simulation set up before this change keeps reading the file its gate's configuration names; there, `rulebook compile` without an output path still writes over it.
params.title: Each simulation compiles the rule book into its own folder
